verified_apis.family_note: Bundled C extension ext/json (json_scanner.c generated by re2c, json_parser.tab.c generated by Bison). Since PHP 8.0 ext/json cannot be disabled. Most Packagist JSON helpers (nette/utils Json, symfony/serializer JsonDecode, beste/json, ergebnis/json, laminas-json by default) call json_decode and share this family.
